root.label: Mary Peltola launches Alaska Senate campaign ad

events.label: Mary Peltola launches Alaska Senate campaign ad

slots.name: NRA rating
slots.sentence: “With me, Alaska comes first,” Peltola said in the ad, before touting her “A rating” from the National Rifle Association (NRA). “I took on Joe Biden to secure the border and push through Alaska’s largest oil project in decades.”
